scope: Local qualification and release checks; anonymous read-only HTTP reads of the Forgejo and GitHub APIs; git ls-remote of both Glide remotes; anonymous reads of homelab-cluster main. No credentials were used against a registry, OpenBao or Kubernetes. No preflight with secrets, no workflow dispatch, no push, tag, publication, variable change or paid model call.

source.remote_note: The local development head is one test-only commit (352fa52) ahead of Forgejo. The preview must run on whatever Forgejo holds when it is dispatched.
source.preview_note: No preview has run since the 14 September preflight fix (dcff13b). The run 23/24 preflight failures predate it; their logs were not read.
source.release_variable: not_observed; no release job has run, which is consistent with it being unset or false

local_qualification.verify_note: Run with PLOEG_TEST_PG_PORT_OFFSET set, because parallel worktrees held the default embedded Postgres port; the first attempt failed only on that port collision.

ploeg_release_policy_tests.skip_reason: Historical one-time version-correction assertion is intentionally opt-in.

limits: Release-worthy commit counts are a git log filter by application path, not a semantic-release calculation; only the preview predicts versions.
No release dry run, ARM64 runtime, live provider, package export or destination publication was qualified.

preflight.dry_run_mode: none; every step after the GitHub repository read needs a CI secret or the Forgejo OIDC token

steps.evidence: has_actions false on webgrip/de-vloer and webgrip/ploeg
The workflow checks out the development head it compares against.
All 67 refs/notes/* are missing on GitHub; heads and 70 tags match.

steps.needs: Forgejo Actions OIDC token and in-cluster OpenBao

remaining_gates.required: Freeze old source/release automation and reconcile intervening tags before enabling Glide.
remaining_gates.evidence: Actions are disabled on both old repositories and neither has a release after rc.16/rc.7. Both still carry the renovate topic and received a chore(renovate) preset commit on 2026-09-22, so they still accept writes; old Ploeg has four open pull requests.
remaining_gates.owner_action: Remove the renovate topic from webgrip/de-vloer and webgrip/ploeg (or archive them), close or port the four open Ploeg pull requests, and record both tips.

remaining_gates.required: GitHub holds the same trunk, tags and release-channel notes as Forgejo.
remaining_gates.evidence: GitHub has 0 of 67 note refs. Since ae10513 only an enabled release push copies notes, so the preflight cannot pass before the gate opens.
remaining_gates.owner_action: Copy the notes once from a clone that passes the strict import verifier: git fetch origin '+refs/notes/*:refs/notes/*' then git push https://github.com/webgrip/glide.git 'refs/notes/*:refs/notes/*' (no --prune).

remaining_gates.required: Qualify per-application GitHub distribution and Ploeg module export.
remaining_gates.evidence: scripts/publish_release.py exports apps/ploeg onto the retained rc.7 commit, pushes only the v-tag to github.com/webgrip/ploeg and compares a fresh go mod download with the Glide tree. It first runs in the first Ploeg publication.

remaining_gates.required: Published source annotations and source revision must identify a repository containing the built Glide commit.
remaining_gates.evidence: All three Dockerfiles and the Ploeg chart name https://github.com/webgrip/glide; the Harbor build adds the index annotation; release_registry.py rejects a wrong source, version or revision on both platforms.

remaining_gates.required: Git-managed OpenBao authorization and a Glide-origin authorization check.
remaining_gates.evidence: homelab-cluster main (d916989) lists webgrip/glide in the cosign-signer bound_claims since 9f521ad6 (2026-09-13). Whether the bootstrap job re-wrote the role in OpenBao, and whether a Glide token receives the policy, needs the preview preflight.

remaining_gates.required: Verify every required publishing identity and extend the Open VSX bridge to Glide.
remaining_gates.evidence: The secret reconciler on main sets VSCODE_EXTENSION_REPO=glide. Existence of OVSX_PAT and registry access from Glide were not observed.

remaining_gates.required: Include Glide in source dependency maintenance and preserve reviewed deployment updates.
remaining_gates.evidence: Discovery moved to the renovate topic on 2026-09-18 (5d4edc5a); webgrip/glide carries it and has had a Renovate Dependency Dashboard since 2026-09-13. Retiring the old repositories remains under release-authority.

remaining_gates.required: Ploeg mirrors must wait for signing; Vloer agent GHCR signatures and attestations need copying and verification.
remaining_gates.evidence: ploeg-release-distribute requires ploeg-release-sign-harbor.outputs.signed; copy_image verifies, copies (cosign copy --only=sig,att,sbom) and re-verifies every image at every destination and fails on error. release-check covers the dependency.

remaining_gates.required: Every published image passes its application's CVE budget before signing.
remaining_gates.evidence: 97bd509 adds the Grype and OpenVEX gate to ploegd before signing; Vloer's two images already had it. The workflow-policy test asserts both.

remaining_gates.required: The notes mirror cannot prune GitHub to an empty set.
remaining_gates.evidence: 0968cf0 requires both source gates; ae10513 adds the push-event and GLIDE_RELEASES_ENABLED conditions; CI sets GLIDE_REQUIRE_IMPORT_NOTES=true.

remaining_gates.required: Run both actual application release dry runs for the final candidate revision.
remaining_gates.evidence: Both applications now have eligible feat/fix commits, so the next preview should predict an rc for each.

remaining_gates.required: For an upgrade of existing data, prove consistent backups and a working restore path; isolated pilots must use separate state.
remaining_gates.evidence: No cluster read in this observation.

remaining_gates.required: First publication, required destination verification, module installation and retry qualification.
Bounded standalone and managed sessions, authority/recovery drills, accounting and cleanup on published artifacts.

discrepancies.migration_md: Says the secret reconciler scopes the Open VSX token to glide and the OpenBao bootstrap lists webgrip/glide; asks for Renovate selection.
discrepancies.record_2026_09_12: oidc-signing and renovate blocked; glide absent at GitOps 80f553ae.
discrepancies.resolution: Both statements were true at their revision. homelab-cluster 9f521ad6 (2026-09-13) added glide to the signing role and the bridge; 5d4edc5a (2026-09-18) moved Renovate to topic discovery, and Glide has the topic and a dashboard.
unverifiable_here: Whether the OpenBao bootstrap CronJob has re-applied the role since 9f521ad6.
Whether a Glide OIDC token obtains the cosign-signer policy.
Whether the OVSX_PAT repository secret exists on webgrip/glide and is accepted by Open VSX.
